name: memo-agent-did-mainnet
description: Create and operate a locally controlled MEMO chain-985 Agent DID without exporting its private key.

interface.shortDescription: Create and connect a local chain-985 Agent DID
interface.longDescription: Create an Agent DID locally, keep its private key in the operating-system credential store, register through the MEMO Agent DID platform, and approve wallet management relationships.
defaultPrompt: Use the MEMO Mainnet Agent DID skill to check secure storage, ensure this installation's local DID, and show only public identity status.
